dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Visible symmetrical 2D narrowing from the mid-body section toward the posterior terminus.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Uniform slate-grey intensity across the visible dorsal plane.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Dark-pixel longitudinal linear feature centered on the dorsal ridge.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Shadow-casting longitudinal indentation along the central dorsal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent longitudinal physical depression or linear scar on the dorsal surface.
